name: pre-deploy
description: 🚀 Pre-deployment checks: critical security, performance, and tests

steps.name: Critical Security Scan
steps.task: Scan ONLY for critical vulnerabilities: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, hardcoded API keys/secrets. Stop immediately if any CRITICAL issues found.

steps.name: Test Coverage Verification
steps.task: Verify that critical business logic has test coverage > 70%. Identify functions without tests that should have them.

steps.name: Performance Bottleneck Check
steps.task: Quick check for obvious performance issues: blocking operations, N+1 queries in critical paths, memory leaks.

steps.name: Deployment Readiness Assessment
